title: 小兔拔萝卜
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled. Subject: one adorable bunny leaning backwards with funny determined cheeks as it pulls ONE oversized carrot from a broad simple soil mound. Asymmetric lively pose, large head and long curved ears, chunky organic feet, a soft rounded tummy. Carrot has just TWO large broad leaves, no interior root hair or vegetable stripes. Bunny has NO fur texture, toe lines, collar, dress, or layered outlines. Simple solid-black eyes with no white highlights, one open smile curve. Absolutely no flowers, grass blades, insects, dots or extra background objects. Aim for only 8–12 big closed coloring shapes, leave the rest of the white background empty; never over 20.
revisionPrompt: Edit this coloring illustration to make it much simpler for children ages 5–12 while retaining the playful professional organic cartoon style and bunny pulling an oversized carrot. Recompose the rabbit with ONE large paw holding the broad carrot at its top, other arm extending to the side; avoid overlapping arm loops and narrow white pockets. The bunny body is one smooth large connected shape with NO belly patch, NO double shoulder line, NO toe divisions. Nose solid black, eyes solid black, mouth only a single OPEN smile curve (NO enclosed white mouth cavity). Make the carrot top just ONE broad leaf growing directly out of the big carrot, with NO thin stalk connectors or collar/ring around its neck. Empty white background, one simple broad ground curve, no tail puff compartments, no extra props. Aim for only 8–10 broad enclosed coloring areas, maximum20. Every enclosed white space must comfortably contain a circle about 5% of the picture width. Preserve lively tilted pose, cute long ears and expressive character; no geometric clip art. Black crisp confident 6px outer/4px inner lines, white paper only, no color, no shading, no textures or lettering.
